Material Symbols Outlined by Google

Source: https://github.com/google/material-design-icons
Upstream revision: 10ecc14790612ca8fd164e3f4ffe9c16fc50d5b7
License: Apache License, Version 2.0 (see LICENSE.txt)

The original SVG files are stored, without path edits, in
src/assets/icons/material-symbols/. The manifest records each upstream path,
Git blob SHA and SHA-256 checksum. The renderer applies the application's
currentColor and dimensions to these local SVG paths. No online icon font or
runtime CDN is used. Star includes Google's original filled variant.

These assets are bundled into the frontend; this notice and LICENSE.txt are
included in desktop packages through the existing third-party/**/* rule.
